text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is a media day for Satono
Diamond, which
includes a photo shoot
where she'll model her
signature
racewear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We arrive at the studio a little ahead of
time. And
right now, she's...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hm-hm-hm-hmmm! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Dressed in her signature racewear,
Satono
Diamond moves around and
strikes different
poses while checking
how she looks on the
monitor.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I need to be confident that what I'm
trying
to convey comes across clearly.
choice_data_list: 入念にチェックしてるな
入念にチェックしてるね

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
When designing this racewear's motif, I

incorporated the feelings that I hold
most dear
each and every day.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm hoping those feelings will come
across to
everyone who reads my article.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, various aspects of
her
signature racewear are rather
striking.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, various aspects of
her
signature racewear are rather
striking.
choice_data_list: ダイヤの飾りが印象的だな
ダイヤの飾りが印象的だね

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, I agree!
choice_data_list: ダイヤの飾りが印象的だな
ダイヤの飾りが印象的だね

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
They represent my name, of course, but
they also
symbolize my unyielding
resolve.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Take stalactites, for example.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
They're formed when rain water seeps
through the
ground and combines with
limestone before
dripping down.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
This water continues to drop in the same
place for
tens, if not hundreds, of
thousands of years,
causing the
stalactites to grow larger and
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I believe the strength of an Umamusume
develops
in a similar manner.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
In other words, we hold firmly to our
beliefs.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We set our minds on a goal and continue
striving
toward it. I believe that is the
path that leads to
victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she speaks, her eyes are filled with a
strong
conviction, much like that which
she incorporated
into the diamond
decorations.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad you noticed them!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I love how cute the ruffles are, of course,
but they
also symbolize flexibility.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The higher and further away your goal is,
the
more hardships you will face along
the way.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No matter how resilient a gemstone may
be, if it
were to clash head on with each
and every one of
those obstacles, it
would surely crack.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So that's why... sometimes it's better to
be pliable
and parry those hardships
aside.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I believe doing so helps reduce needless
worry
and allows one to focus on the
road ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she speaks, her eyes are filled with a
soft light,
much like the gentle
conviction she incorporated
into the
design of her ruffles.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We talk for a while, but there's still some
time
before the photo shoot.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's a splendid idea. Let's have some
tea!
choice_data_list: 飲み物でも飲みながら待とうか
飲み物でも飲みながら待とっか

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um... Is there somewhere we can buy tea
around
here?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The vending machine! I thought it
looked a little
different to the usual
ones, so I wanted to check
it out!
choice_data_list: 確か、廊下に自動販売機が――

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Leave this to me. I'll go buy us some tea.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I watch as she eagerly heads off to get
the tea.
...However, I start to worry when
I recall her
saying the machine looked
different.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Realizing I should have gone too, I
follow after
her...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? I don't see any cans or bottles.
Am I
supposed to touch this panel? Or
this button?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clunk, clunk.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh! A cup came out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clatter, clatter!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Ice?! Not tea? Should I stop it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While she continues to build on her
strengths,
there are still areas that she
needs to work on. I
decide to keep a
closer eye on her in the future.
choice_data_list: すぐ行くから、そのまま待ってて！
